title: How an island suddenly rose from the Mediterranean in 1831 then vanished
summary_full: In 1831, fishermen spotted a temporary volcanic island off the coast of Sicily, prompting European powers to hastily claim the new territory, leading to several international disputes. Unfortunately, the island, primarily composed of lightweight rocks, eroded rapidly, disappearing into the Mediterranean within months. Today, its remnants lie submerged, creating a unique habitat for marine life and documented on maritime maps.
